ayahs.1: O you wrapped in your garments—
ayahs.2: stand in night prayer for most of the night, except a little—
ayahs.3: half of it, or a little less,
ayahs.4: or a little more—and recite the Qur'an in a measured, deliberate way.
ayahs.5: We will soon send down upon you a weighty revelation.
ayahs.6: Night worship cuts deeper and makes recitation more focused.
ayahs.7: By day you are burdened with worldly duties.
ayahs.8: Remember the Name of your Rabb, and devote yourself to Him with your whole heart.
ayahs.9: He is Rabb of east and west. There is no god worthy of worship except Him—take Him alone as the One you trust with all affairs.
ayahs.10: Be patient with what they say, and leave them courteously.
ayahs.11: Leave the deniers—those absorbed in luxury—to Me, and bear with them a little longer.
ayahs.12: We have shackles, a raging Fire,
ayahs.13: choking food, and a painful punishment waiting for them
ayahs.14: on the Day the earth and mountains convulse, and mountains become dunes of shifting sand.
ayahs.15: We sent you a messenger as a witness over you, just as We sent a messenger to Pharaoh.
ayahs.16: Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a crushing grip.
ayahs.17: If you persist in rejection, how will you guard yourselves against a Day that turns children's hair grey?
ayahs.18: A Day when the sky will split apart. His promise of judgment must be fulfilled.
ayahs.19: This is a reminder. Let whoever wills take the path back to their Rabb.
ayahs.20: Your Rabb knows you stand in prayer nearly two-thirds of the night, or half, or a third—and so do some believers with you. He measures night and day precisely. He knows you cannot keep that burden, and has eased it for you in mercy. So recite whatever you can of the Qur'an. He knows some of you are ill, some travel seeking Allah's bounty, and some strive in Allah's cause. Recite what you can. Establish salah—the formal prayer—pay zakat—the obligatory sharing of wealth—and lend Allah a good loan. Whatever good you send ahead, you will find it with Allah, better and greater in reward. And seek Allah's forgiveness. He is All-Forgiving, the Rahim.
